content: Standard 2025/2026 Python Docker pattern: multi-stage build with a 'builder' stage (has uv/compilers) that installs deps into a venv, and a slim final stage (python:3.14-slim, e.g. 3.14.7-slim-trixie, ~41MB base) that copies only the venv + app code — no build tools shipped. Separate COPY of dependency files (uv.lock/pyproject.toml or requirements.txt) before COPY of source code maximizes layer cache hits. python:3.14-slim is published and current as of this research (3.14.7).
